explanation: The central tree preserves the proposal lifecycle while reducing the seed from 105 to 66 lines (37.1%) and from 7107 to 4309 characters (39.4%). Six peripheral trees expand workflow access and lifetime, push intake, evidence identities, concurrency and recovery, persistence, and review. The trees mix modular boundaries, calls, ownership and concrete data requirements; indentation groups concepts, while edges connect central concepts to their details. New source-grounded details include interrupted-run reporting (diffSessionWorkflowService.ts), the oversized default DiffTree fallback and mapping-only updates (diffTree.ts), manifest-token ownership and 16-entry caches (diagramChangeSessionStore.ts and changeSessionRecords.ts), and preview worker cleanup and acceptance retry IDs (ChangeSessionPreview.tsx). Corrections: edits do not invariably leave a session in draft; ChangeSessionService.update can edit, set draft, then validate and set ready in the same call. Acceptance checks session version and live document content/name, not capturedVersion; it passes savedRevisionId to the catalog. Full hunk coverage belongs to complete_diff_session, not the general validateReady gate. Default commit grouping has a single-node fallback when ASCII exceeds 20000 characters. Uncertainty: only the supplied snapshot was used. The point describes atomic catalog publication, but the catalog implementation is absent; the diagram marks that boundary without asserting a verified transaction. Pinned source reads are the supplied tool's documented contract, but the injected source-reader implementation is absent. Imported helpers are not treated as independently verified implementations.

Workflow stages and resource ownership
|-- DiffSessionWorkflowService.start
|   |-- Hash requestId into run ID; compare parsed request on replay
|   `-- Store run; retain AbortController and live run until execution ends
|-- Capture before opening the agent session
|   |-- Reject missing context or empty hunks
|   `-- Persist capture and prompts as artifacts
|-- DiffSessionTools exposes tools by stage
|   |-- analyze: baseline search, captured hunks, API discovery, source reader
|   |   `-- Source reader promises pinned revisions; implementation not supplied
|   `-- materialize: create proposal from the same frozen capture
|       |-- Bound tool calls reject a different changeSessionId
|       |-- Expose exec, drawing, mappings, proposal updates and DiffTree reads
|       `-- complete_diff_session checks ready + changes + every captured hunk
|-- Final service check: returned proposal is this run's own ready proposal
|-- Persist step requests/responses, transcript and performance metrics
`-- Completion, failure or cancellation -> finally
    |-- Dispose agent session; save final run; remove active/live entries
    |-- cancel aborts the run; service disposal aborts all active runs
    `-- get reports a stored running run as interrupted if no active start/run

Push identity and pinned Git inputs
|-- PushIntegrationService.receive(connectionId, event)
|   |-- Hash connectionId + eventId into generation ID
|   |-- Pending promise / stored generation reuse matching payloads
|   |   `-- Different payload -> PUSH_EVENT_ID_CONFLICT
|   `-- Recheck pending work after asynchronous reads to share races
|-- New generation requires enabled connection and push integration
|-- GitPushSource.resolve
|   |-- Find checkout whose repository identity matches registration
|   |-- Fetch missing before/after commit objects; verify availability
|   |-- Reject shallow repository and more than 2000 discovered commits
|   |-- Walk after excluding before, in reverse topological order
|   |-- Missing before -> new branch; ancestry failure code 1 -> force push
|   `-- Compare trees; null before uses SHA-1 or SHA-256 empty-tree hash
|-- Workflow request uses generation ID as requestId
|   `-- Captures net before-to-after changes, even across many commits
`-- Generation retains workflowRunId
    `-- get refreshes status, proposal ID and error while generation is running

DiffTree and migration identity
|-- DiffTree owns revision, mappings and immutable captured hunks
|   |-- Line-based mapping input resolves to a persisted node reference
|   |-- Existing tree requires exact expectedRevisionId
|   |   `-- Omitted ASCII retains revision; mappings still replace in full
|   |-- Validate unique node refs, hunk IDs and mapping IDs
|   |   `-- Reject unknown nodes/hunks and duplicate targets in a mapping
|   |-- Default: one node per commit
|   |   `-- Over 20000 characters -> one Selected commits node maps all hunks
|   `-- Selected-node reads deduplicate resolved hunks
|       `-- Explicit hunkIds override selection; patches are optional
|-- Mapping validity does not require all hunks to be covered
|   `-- complete_diff_session adds the full-coverage check
`-- Migration endpoints describe transfers
    |-- Source may use baseline or proposed; destination must use proposed
    |-- Match exact document, grid diagram, revision and content node
    |-- subtree scope recursively selects descendants
    `-- Duplicate migration IDs or stale endpoints produce issues

Versions, retries and acceptance recovery
|-- Separate concurrency identities
|   |-- Session version guards update and accept
|   |-- Document version goes to controller.applyUpdate
|   |-- DiffTree expectedRevisionId guards tree/mapping replacement
|   `-- Manifest token guards writes when an expected token is supplied
|-- Mutations replay receipts before checking status or executing changes
|   |-- Same request signature -> previous result
|   |-- Different signature -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   `-- New mutations reject accepted/archived sessions and 2000 receipts
|-- Edit status ordering
|   `-- update can edit, set draft, then validate and set ready in one call
|-- accept compares live document hashes and names to captured baselines
|   |-- capturedVersion is retained but is not compared here
|   `-- savedRevisionId is passed to the catalog as expectedRevisionId
|-- Catalog publication returns an acceptance receipt
|   |-- Receipt retains change IDs and before/after checkpoint references
|   `-- Atomic publication is stated by the point; catalog code is absent
`-- finishAcceptance requires saved version == receipt.sessionVersion
    |-- Write accepted status at receipt.sessionVersion + 1
    `-- Ready records with matching receipts recover through get/accept

Persistence boundaries and retained state
|-- DiagramChangeSessionStore exposes repository reads and scoped writes
|   |-- WeakMap associates hydrated session objects with manifest tokens
|   `-- Worker histories register revisions locally before controller use
|-- ChangeSessionRecords hides blobs, manifests and caches
|   |-- Manifest: summary + document refs + receipt-map ref + DiffTree ref
|   |-- Document: metadata + baseline/proposed refs + history refs
|   |   `-- History header separate from individual checkpoint records
|   |-- Scoped writes retain unaffected records
|   `-- Per-manifest queue compares supplied expected token, then publishes
|-- Read boundaries
|   |-- Summary avoids restoring histories and receipts
|   |-- Preview restores only baseline/proposed; returns a clone
|   |-- Full read restores histories, DiffTree and replay receipts
|   `-- Preview and validated-document caches each retain at most 16 entries
`-- Legacy compatibility
    |-- Summary cache uses inode, size, mtime and ctime stamp
    |-- Migration splits legacy stored references into immutable records
    `-- Controller imports old undo states; canonical history then owns them

Review data and local UI lifetime
|-- ChangeSessionPreview creates a worker per session/document selection
|   |-- Send preview URL with documentId and last-seen session version
|   |-- Schedule refresh after 2 seconds unless accepted/archived returned
|   `-- Selection change/unmount clears timer and terminates worker
|-- DiagramDiffCanvas clones proposed state into ChangePreviewState
|   |-- Prepare expanded diff layout before local folding
|   |-- Clear initial diagramViews; local controls update preview state
|   |-- Search reveal checks revision and ASCII hash before unfolding focus
|   `-- Linked-canvas jumps reject destinations outside the proposal
|-- Accept button retains request ID for the same session/version
|   `-- Accept, reread session, invoke onOpenAccepted
`-- Service readTreemaps
    |-- Read captured DiffTree and document previews in batches of four
    |-- Compare each effective preview version to captured version
    |-- Recheck effective summary version after collecting previews
    `-- Any mismatch -> VERSION_CONFLICT; retry
